cover_headline: Kerala-Born Nithya Raman Unseats Karen Bass to Become Los Angeles Mayor
facts: County returns on Wednesday afternoon put Raman ahead 51.67 percent to 48.33 percent, with 405,193 votes against Bass's 379,069
Born in Kerala in 1981, Raman came to the United States at age six and graduated from Harvard in 2003
In 2020 she unseated Councilmember David Ryu in the 4th District, becoming the first South Asian elected to the City Council

end.headline: Kerala-Born Nithya Raman Unseats Karen Bass to Become Los Angeles Mayor
end.line: The 45-year-old council member will be the city's first Asian American mayor after Bass conceded Thursday, capping a midterm that also sent Amish Shah and Pia Dandiya to Congress.
